relations.text: 2021年の供給契約でPeloton向けの運動器具部品を製造(契約を巡り訴訟)
relations.text_en: Made custom parts for Peloton under a 2021 supply agreement, which became the subject of a lawsuit

source.label: Mayville Engineering 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: The lawsuit arose from a March 2021 Supply Agreement between the parties, pursuant to which MEC was to manufacture and supply custom component parts for Peloton's exercise

relations.text: 特許訴訟の和解として、Pelotonの運動器具を対象に7,500万ドルのライセンス契約を締結
relations.text_en: Signed a $75 million license covering Peloton exercise equipment to settle patent litigation

source.label: EchoStar 10-Q(2024年8月)
source.quote: On May 1, 2023, we entered into a $75 million license agreement covering Peloton exercise equipment that resolves our litigation involving those products.

source.quote: Reservoir has direct licensing agreements with platforms including TikTok, Peloton, Meta and Snap.
